name: Orca 软件 Tokens 统计插件
description: Real-time token usage, per-request TPS, TTFT, and prompt-cache hit rate statistics plugin for Orca IDE (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi), powered by CC Switch metrics.

cover.alt: Orca Tokens & Per-Request TPS Stats cover showing live status bar speed and per-request sidebar cards with TTFT and cache hit rates

screenshots.alt: Orca dark workspace with the TPS & Token Statistics sidebar panel showing per-request speed, TTFT, subagent badges, and status bar
screenshots.caption: Dark theme: live per-request TPS, TTFT, output tokens, and prompt-cache hit rate

screenshots.alt: Orca light workspace with the TPS & Token Statistics sidebar panel showing per-request speed, TTFT, subagent badges, and status bar
screenshots.caption: Light theme: automatic Orca theme adaptation and compact responsive layout

statusBarItems.tooltip: 最新请求速度与缓存命中率（CC Switch 算法）；右侧对话 TPS 查看请求明细，点击刷新。

settings.title: 启用战况天梯同步
settings.description: 开启后仅上传按日脱敏汇总的 Token 计数（不含对话内容、路径或会话信息）。需先在「战况天梯」面板登录或匿名加入。

settings.title: 战况天梯服务端地址
settings.description: 支持自建服务端或本地测试服务（默认 http://127.0.0.1:8787）。

settings.title: 天梯隐身模式
settings.description: 开启后在公开榜单中隐藏自己的昵称与头像（仅自己可见实际名次）。
